SLICE ONE LANDED c5a119a: view measured, MIRROR DOOR OPEN ON 21 OF 21.

That is the answer I asked for before anyone converts a type. Extrapolating from one demonstrated
forge (CostBreakdown) to 38 would have been assumption; 21 more measured makes it evidence, and it
strongly implies the remaining 13 in core, codec, features and align behave identically -- the shape
is what derives the Mirror, not the module.

Test pins the known-bad state so the suite stays green while the defect is tracked, with a positive
control for the summon door specifically and a mutation I ran (pointed Extent at a proven-sealed
type; the test failed as intended; reverted and verified).

Remaining population: features 4 (FeatureUseLedger, BoundaryScore, NarrativeWindowPlan,
DerivationGraph), plus core, codec and align. I am NOT measuring align tonight -- two batch-1
candidates live there and a test-count change would invalidate their gate evidence. features is
untouched by any pending candidate and is the natural next slice for whoever picks it up.
